g.text: Two small Android apps that do one
job each. Both work offline, both ask
for nothing but the files you hand
them, and both are signed with the
same key so one can hand you to the
One for glyphs, one for photos
Both free brands in your pocket: pick a
glyph, set its weight, size and
background in a live preview, open the
whole set in a scrolling sheet, copy the

These are self-signed builds, so Play Protect may

No SDKs, no analytics, no network
Icons 2.3 · All brands in the app
The left pull-down opens with All, and the
page behind it travels inside the APK: a tab
per brand over a sheet of twenty glyphs,
one from each category, so the two sets
can be read side by side with the radio off.
The zip estimate moved into the line under
the Export button, where the running
summary used to be, and the collected
glyphs now wrap into rows instead of
running off the edge of the tab.
Double-tap a glyph in the sheet and it
collects into a tab above it, with Remove
selected and Remove all. Add all takes the
whole category, and a category change
starts the selection clean. The line under
the preview estimates the zip before you
Format is a pull-down like the size: SVG, PNG,
WEBP or JPG, one at a time, and the copy
button renames itself to match. The two
Your background choice now sticks per
brand alongside the format and the size, so
a white tile survives a reload and the
Icons 1.8 · One size, in a list
The export size is now a pull-down holding
all six sizes from 32 to 1024px, instead of a
row that had to squeeze. What you pick still
Icons 1.7 · Sizes on two rows, and a
The six export sizes now sit on two rows, so
none of them is squeezed. The format and
size you pick are remembered per brand,
and on the site copying a raster also puts a
PNG on the clipboard to paste straight into
Icons 1.6 · Whole sets at any size
The export size now runs from 32 to 1024px,
and one button packs every glyph the
sheet shows into a single zip, in the format
you picked. Inside the app that zip lands in
Copy hands over the SVG, or a 512px PNG,
WEBP or JPG drawn on the black or white
background. The app saves those to

and a camera cutout, so the band is no

The preview tile is a black or white swatch
now, labelled as such, instead of the
The category you picked last is restored the
